name: HTTP Response Headers
description: HTTP header manipulations to improve performance and secure HTTP headers.
project_description:
What is the HTTP Response Headers module? 
 This module allows to set HTTP response headers (both standard and non-standard) on pages by various visibility rule settings. Currently the headers can be set by path, content type and user role.

 Key Features 
 
 Configure list of allowed headers 
 Ability to configure HTTP headers per content type. 
 Ability to configure HTTP headers per page. 
 Ability to configure HTTP headers per user role. 
 Ability to configure HTTP headers per response status. 
 The module is using conditions plugins and can be extended. This potentially should also work with Groups module and other modules which provide condition plugins. 
 
 Features in Drupal 7 version may vary from Drupal 10 version.
